paper_title: Ultralight vector dark matter search using data from the KAGRA O3GK run
suggested_experiment_name: KAGRA O3GK U(1)_B-L vector DM search
notes: Search for U(1)_B-L gauge boson dark matter using KAGRA O3GK auxiliary length channels (MICH and PRCL data). Coupling type VectorBL is unambiguous. However, actual numerical exclusion curve is only shown in Fig. 5 (not readable in this text) and no data table is provided. Text states the upper limit on epsilon_B-L is 'at best O(10^-20)' over the analyzed frequency band. Mass range O(10^-14 - 10^-11) eV corresponds to O(10-1000) Hz. The provided data points are a rough O(1e-20) flat approximation spanning the target mass range; the true curve varies with frequency and is not extractable numerically from the text.
